# mergeah_access_key (Resource)

Manage a Merge access key. Changes replace the key. The secret is returned only on creation and is stored in sensitive Terraform state; import cannot recover it. Omitted expires_at uses the API default (90 days). Set no_expiration to true to explicitly request no expiration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
resource "mergeah_access_key" "example" {
  name   = "terraform-managed"
  scopes = ["management:all"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) Merge API field `expires_at`. Changes require replacement.
- `is_test` (Boolean) Merge API field `is_test`. Changes require replacement. Defaults to `false`.
- `name` (String) Merge API field `name`. Changes require replacement.
- `no_expiration` (Boolean) Merge API field `no_expiration`. Changes require replacement. Defaults to `false`.
- `registered_user_ids` (Set of String) Merge API field `registered_user_ids`. Changes require replacement.
- `scopes` (Set of String) Merge API field `scopes`. Changes require replacement.
- `tool_pack_ids` (Set of String) Merge API field `tool_pack_ids`. Changes require replacement.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Value reported by Merge: `created_at`.
- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier. See the Import section for its format.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) Value reported by Merge: `key`.
- `key_masked` (String) Value reported by Merge: `key_masked`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mergeah_access_key.example '134e0111-0f67-44f6-98f0-597000290bb3'
```
